notes:
- Added an outline for activity and faction merchant markers.
- Incomplete quests now have a gray marker. When a quest can be turned in or is completed, it turns green.
- Minimap and enhanced main map can now be individually enabled/disabled.
- Added dungeons, rifts, and soulstones to activity subfilters.
- Added obelisks, respawns, faction merchants, and stations to NPC subfilters.
- Clicking the heroic bonus dungeon indicator in the main map now pans the map to the dungeon.
- The filter settings button next to the minimap now appears inside the corner of the square minimap instead of next to it. Circular minimap is unchanged.
- The position of the minimap filter buttons can now be chosen as either the left or right side of the minimap.
- Changed the "Circular minimap" toggle to a "Minimap shape" dropdown. The options are "Circular" and "Square".
